generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: Document for Forestry work experience issued by not below the rank of Deputy Conservator of Forests. (Nursery Raising works)
Tenderer should produce Forest Contractor registration certificate for having registered as a forest contractor for year 2026-27 in (Any Forest Divisions of Karnataka Forest Department)
Liquid Assets and/or availability of Credit Facility of not less than 50% of the estimated cost of the tender. (Issued by the competent authority)
Income Tax returns filing copies of the last 3 years (2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26)
GST Registration certificate. & last Three year (2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26) GST Returns.
Notary Affidavit for not black listed and not being a defaulter in any Forest Division / Government Office.
Permenent Address proof (Aadhar Card/EPIC card/Driving license/pass port/ bank pass book or any other documents issued by competent government authority.
Cast Certificate for reserved Indents only
